notes: Easier to get around the counter. Click any computer on Overview, Computers or Sessions to open a panel with its actions: the rate card as buttons, add or deduct time, open or end the session, restart or shut down. The Needs a look tile opens just those computers. Settings has a list of its sections down the left that jumps to each one, and Sign out now fits on the counter's screen. Goes with terminal 1.50.0.
